items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: What do you want to play for your friend?

ctx.x: Oh, it's not quite ready yet, Billy. It ain't ready yet.
Make it good and hot, sister. Oh, good and hot. That's right. Nick, what do you want me to play for you? I don't know. What do you want to play? What do you want to play for your friend?
